description: bookA and bookB run sequentially (bookA -> bookB), each registering a compensation subscription on the SAME `cancel` handler element. The compensation throw then activates one handler instance per completed activity — two `cancel` instances bound to the same element id in one scope (#897). Completing ONE handler job must retire exactly that handler instance (by element-INSTANCE key) and must NOT route the throw onward while the other handler is still pending. (The harness selects the newest job of a type, so a second completion would re-target the completed job — #1401 — and is covered by the engine-core unit tests instead.)
